metadata.description: Architectural rejection catalog: external quant components rejected from core integration

rejected_components.source: Generic retail indicators (RSI, MACD, Stochastics, Bollinger Bands)
rejected_components.rationale: The permanent Market Model consists strictly of Structure/Trend, Key Zones/Levels, and Phase. Hardcoding technical indicators into the core market state definition corrupts market physics with ad-hoc heuristics. Technical indicators may only exist as optional observations in the Observation Registry.

Direct copying or static linking of GPL-3.0 source code would legally obligate the entire crypto-platform repository to adopt GPL-3.0. Conceptual algorithmic inspiration is allowed; direct source copying is strictly prohibited.

rejected_components.source: Naive VectorBT / Pandas shiftless signal generation
rejected_components.rationale: Vectorized signal generation frequently leaks future bar close data into entry price simulation. Our causal event-driven execution with adverse-first intrabar checking must remain the absolute standard.
All core research and simulation infrastructure must remain open, auditable, and self-hosted without dependency on external commercial binaries.

rejected_components.source: Direct ML price forecasting / next-bar price regressors
rejected_components.rationale: Financial time-series price levels are non-stationary. Training neural networks to directly forecast raw price levels fails out-of-sample. ML may only be used as a conditional ranker for discrete structural candidate signals.
